title: [review] 03-adaptation.md: Rule 7 description contradicts tabl
description: Text states 'Rule 7 supports both link-local and global addresses (via address-mode bit) and direction bit + residue for the non-10883 port' but the table at lines 117-130 shows only link-local prefixes (fe80::/64) and both SrcPort/DstPort as TV=10883 with CDA=not-sent. The described address-mode bit and direction bit are not reflected in the table.
close_reason: Fixed: Updated Rule 7 table in 03-adaptation.md to match the actual implementation in codec.rs. The table now correctly shows the address-mode bit (1 bit for link-local vs global), conditional address sizes (64-bit IID for link-local, 128-bit for global), direction bit (which port is 10883), and OtherPort field. Updated compressed size from incorrect 18 bytes to 21 bytes (link-local) / 37 bytes (global).
